# arcwind logo

Two streamlines spiraling up a widening cone above the disk: the red-shifted
(orange) and blue-shifted (blue) sides of the conical wind.

Colors: navy `#0F1B2D`, cream `#F7F5F0`, orange `#D9622B`, blue `#2F6DB5`.
Wordmark: Inter Display Bold, converted to outlines (no font needed).

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `arcwind-banner-light-transparent.svg` / `-dark-transparent.svg` | README header and docs sidebar (light / dark themes) |
| `arcwind-banner-{light,dark}.svg`, `*@2x.png` | banner on a solid background (slides, posters) |
| `arcwind-logo-{light,dark}[-transparent].svg` | stacked logo |
| `arcwind-mark-{light,dark}.svg` | helix alone |
| `arcwind-icon-{light,dark}.svg`, `*-512.png` | GitHub avatar / social preview |
| `arcwind-favicon-{light,dark}.svg`, `favicon.ico` | browser tab (thicker strokes for small sizes) |

Regenerate with `python make_logos.py OUTDIR`.
